why: Captain, your rebuilt MBR flow holds together end to end: the Reviews entry screen, the collection step, the builder, the lock/discard dialogs, the read-only Preview and the published View all match the mockup's layout, wording and transitions, and every high-impact criterion I could reach worked. The per-month lock, the insight-completeness gate ('16 of 19 KPIs · 3 still empty'), the Carried pills, cohort deltas and the X off-track marker are all present and correct. The one real caveat: this build's data has no automated KPIs, so the refresh-all box, the wired 'Auto'/Collect cells and re-pull could not be observed at all — they are untested, not broken. I recommend MEDIUM: ship-with-known-unknowns, and if you want those automation surfaces confirmed, re-run Verify against a month that includes at least one wired KPI.

why: Captain, the redesigned MBR flow is solid and closely tracks your mockup: the Reviews entry screen, the data-pull collection screen, the builder (head, amber draft banner, insight-completion bar, per-bucket cards, editable status with a distinct off-track X, cohort deltas, Carried pills, manual inline cells) and the per-month Lock dialog with its insight gate all render and behave as asked, and Preview renders the draft read-only exactly as it will publish. Your whole test suite is green (622/622). The one soft spot is data, not build: this seed wires no automated KPIs, so the 'Update all automatically' refresh-all box, the wired value-cell controls and the re-pull path had nothing to show and I could not verify them; and because 3 insights are still blank the true locked state, the discard and month-unlock dialogs, and the published 'View' jump were not reached. Every high-impact criterion I could reach worked, so I recommend shipping with those data-gated items flagged as known unverified — medium.
